publicGates.command: node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('exports '+k)}; for(const n of ['tokenize','parse','evaluate','run','createEnv']){A(typeof x[n]==='function','missing '+n);}"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('prec '+k)}; A(x.evaluate(x.parse(x.tokenize('2 + 3 * 4')))===14,'pipe'); A(x.run('2 + 3 * 4')===14,'run'); A(x.run('(2 + 3) * 4')===20,'parens'); A(x.run('10 - 2 - 3')===5,'left');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('pow '+k)}; A(x.run('2 \u005e 3 \u005e 2')===512,'rassoc'); A(x.run('2 * 3 \u005e 2')===18,'powmul'); A(x.run('-2 \u005e 2')===-4,'unarypow'); A(x.run('2 * -3')===-6,'unary');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('fn '+k)}; A(x.run('sqrt(16) + abs(-3)')===7,'sqrtabs'); A(x.run('max(2, 9) - min(4, 1)')===8,'maxmin'); A(x.run('pow(2, 10)')===1024,'pow');"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('dec '+k)}; A(x.run('3.5 * 2')===7,'mul'); A(x.run('1 / 4')===0.25,'div'); A(x.run('floor(3.9)')===3,'floor'); A(x.run('ceil(3.1)')===4,'ceil');"
node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('var '+k)}; A(x.run('x = 5; x * 2')===10,'assign'); A(x.run('a = 3; b = 4; a*a + b*b')===25,'multi');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('env '+k)}; const e=x.createEnv(); x.run('n = 7', e); A(x.run('n * 2', e)===14,'share'); const e2=x.createEnv(); let t=false; try{x.run('n * 2', e2)}catch(err){t=true} A(t===true,'isolated');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const T=(fn,rx,k)=>{let e=null;try{fn()}catch(z){e=z} if(!e)throw new Error('no throw '+k); if(!rx.test(e.message))throw new Error('msg '+k+': '+e.message)}; T(()=>x.run('1 / 0'),/division by zero/i,'divzero'); T(()=>x.run('y + 1'),/undefined variable/i,'undef'); T(()=>x.run('foo(2)'),/unknown function/i,'unknownfn'); T(()=>x.run('2 +'),/syntax error/i,'syntax'); T(()=>x.run('(2 + 3'),/syntax error/i,'unbalanced');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('stage '+k)}; A(Array.isArray(x.tokenize('2 + 2')),'tokarr'); const env=x.createEnv(); x.evaluate(x.parse(x.tokenize('k = 9')), env); A(x.evaluate(x.parse(x.tokenize('k + 1')), env)===10,'evalenv');"

node -e "const x=require('./src/index'); const A=(c,k)=>{if(!c)throw new Error('ws '+k)}; A(x.run('  2+3 ')===5,'ws'); A(x.run('100 / 10 / 2')===5,'divassoc'); A(x.run('2 \u005e 2 \u005e 3')===256,'rassoc2');"
